messages:
Maya: Quick sync — proposal for 'region shielding' + routing econ.
Maya: TL;DR: two lanes: 1) high-affinity SLA lanes (reserved/dedicated), 2) pooled best-effort lanes (hosted). Need clear launch criteria & mapping to customer asks.
Sam: love the split. can we add quant gates? e.g., expected p95 latency < 80ms for lane1, cost delta < 3x vs hosted.
Alex: agree. also add model-aware routing: fall back to quantized variant if lane1 capacity saturated. want to capture compatibility matrix for model variants.
Liz: operational note — cross-region failover needs traffic shaping. we can't cold-migrate tenants without throttles and evacuation windows. include SLOs for failover.
Rachel: from SEs — customers want 'pin to region' + audit logs and KMS integration. launch criteria should include an audit-proof demo and config knobs in console.
Sam: propose rollout phases: alpha internal -> pilot customers (3) -> GA. pilot acceptance: 99.9% uptime for pilot, two successful tenant migrations, zero data-leakage incidents.
Maya: good. add gating: infra tooling (route policy UI + API), rollout playbook, migration script, cost modeling docs, and a regression eval for output quality.
Alex: small config snippet for policy we discussed:
```
policy {
  match: tenant.id
  prefer: lane:sla
  fallback: lane:pooled
  constraints: [region, model-compat]
}
```
Alex: will also surface policy precedence and how canary/rollbacks work when variants differ.
Liz: ops checklist: circuit-breakers, telemetry (per-lane token cost, p50/p95 latency, tail-latency distribution), automated rollback hooks, evacuation runbook. need runbook rehearsals.
ops-bot: Reminder: RFC draft due Fri 03/18. Please attach proto diagram + perf sims to the RFC.
Maya: I'll draft the RFC and link to the product board. tagging @Sam @Alex for section owners. anyone else want to be listed as an approver?
Rachel: I'll coordinate pilot customers and write migration runbook. will ask legal for audit acceptance criteria.
Sam: I'll own metrics & launch criteria and pull baseline econ numbers.
Alex: I'll own policy spec, variant compatibility matrix, and the fallback semantics.
Liz: ops will run chaos tests in staging and sign off on the runbook.
Maya: next meeting Wed 10am to review RFC. please add agenda items to the doc. :thumbsup:
_notes: Thread about long-term platform roadmap: routing policies, multi-region, multi-tenant isolation, launch criteria and pilot plan. Kept short, realistic Slack style with an ops-bot reminder.
